name: 비디오 선명도 분석
algorithm: Video Sharpness — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes video sharpness for forensic detection:

1. **Per-FrameSharpness측정**: Global and local sharpness metrics (edge acutance, MTF50, high-frequency energy ratio) are computed per frame. This quantifies the optical sharpness of the video content.

2. **Sharpness공간적분포**: Sharpness variation across the frame should follow optical physics: (a) sharp at the focal plane, (b) decreasing with defocus, (c) potentially reduced at frame corners from lens aberrations. The method checks for physically motivated sharpness distribution. AI-generated content may show unnatural sharpness patterns.

3. **얼굴-BackgroundSharpnessMatch**: The sharpness characteristics of face and background should be consistent with the same optical system and focus distance. The method detects sharpness mismatches — generated faces that are sharper or softer than expected for their position in the scene's depth of field.

4. **시간적Sharpness일관성**: Sharpness should vary smoothly over time (focus changes are gradual). The method tracks frame-to-frame sharpness — rapid, unphysical sharpness changes indicate generation artifacts (variable output quality from the generator).

5. **Sharpness에지프로파일분석**: The sub-pixel edge profile at sharp boundaries characterizes the imaging system's optical transfer function. The method compares edge profiles between face and background — different edge profiles indicate content from different optical or rendering pipelines.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through 비디오 sharpness analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
